notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Yawgmoth's second ability by paying {B}{B} and discarding Voidwing Hybrid, causing you to put two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Voidwing Hybrid triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
